title: landmark
description: The `landmark` content kind (megaplan 1.7 and task 7-A1): a named place of Night City the Holo-Table can spawn a player at and a `contract` can send them to (`reach_landmark`). One place per file. `pos` is a Minecraft position in the replica ([x, y, z]; the Cyberpunk position (x, y, z) is the Minecraft position (x, z, -y), section 1.9), `yaw` the way the player faces on arrival (Minecraft yaw: 0 south, 90 west, 180 north, 270 east), `district` the district name the way the game's own district label spells it (shown on the Holo-Table), `kind` what sort of place it is (a district's own spawn is `district`) and `description` one original sentence. `approx` is true while the position was written without game data to check it: the table snaps the arrival to the ground and refuses a spawn with no ground (`vteleported` reason `no ground`), so an approximate point costs a refused spawn, never a stuck player, and a `reach_landmark` gig counts an approximate point by x and z only (within 6 blocks, any height), so a wrong guessed height never leaves a gig that cannot be finished; a datapack or a later release replaces the file with a measured position and `approx` false. A file with the same id as a default replaces it, so a datapack ships only the places it changes.
